headlines.summary: 【北京出台房地产新政策 适度提高住房公积金最高贷款额度】北京市住房和城乡建设委员会、北京市规划和自然资源委员会、北京住房公积金管理中心7日晚联合印发《关于进一步优化调整本市房地产政策的通知》，适度提高住房公积金最高贷款额度。购房家庭中1人为公积金缴存人的，购买首套住房公积金贷款最高贷款额度为120万元，二套住房公积金贷款最高额度为100万元；夫妻双方均为缴存人的，购买首套住房公积金贷款最高贷款额度为240万元，二套住房公积金贷款最高额度为200万元。符合以下条件的，最高贷款额度可进一步上浮。

headlines.title_en: Beijing introduces new real estate policies, moderately raising maximum housing provident fund loan limits
headlines.summary_en: [Beijing rolls out new real estate policies, moderately raising the maximum housing provident fund loan limit] The Beijing Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources, and the Beijing Housing Provident Fund Management Center jointly issued the "Notice on Further Optimizing and Adjusting the City's Real Estate Policies" on the evening of the 7th, moderately raising the maximum housing provident fund loan limit. For homebuying families where one member is a provident fund contributor, the maximum loan for a first home is 1.2 million yuan, and for a second home, 1 million yuan; where both spouses are contributors, the maximum loan for a first home is 2.4 million yuan, and for a second home, 2 million yuan. The maximum loan limit may be further increased under qualifying conditions.

headlines.summary: 周五（8月7日）欧市尾盘，德国10年期国债收益率跌0.8个基点，报3.132%，北京时间20:30发布美国非农就业报告时从3.147%跳水、20:41刷新日低至3.117%，本周累计下跌7.4个基点，8月5日欧股开盘前低开至3.088% 两年期德债收益率跌1.3个基点，报2.750%，非农就业报告发布前60秒微幅上涨至2.768%刷新日高、随后在20:41刷新日低至2.725%，本周累跌7.2个基点，8月5日曾低开至2.704%；30年期德债收益率累跌6.4个基点，报3.640%。 2/10年期德债收益率利差累跌0.364个基点，报+37.985个基点。

headlines.title_en: Germany 2/10-year bond yields fall over 7 basis points this week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (August 7) during the European session tail end, Germany's 10-year bond yield fell 0.8 bps to 3.132%, plunging from 3.147% at 20:30 Beijing time upon release of the U.S. nonfarm payrolls report, refreshing the day's low to 3.117% at 20:41, with a weekly cumulative decline of 7.4 bps; on August 5, it opened lower at 3.088% before the European stock open. The 2-year German bond yield fell 1.3 bps to 2.750%, briefly rising to 2.768% 60 seconds before the payrolls report to refresh the day's high, then hitting a daily low of 2.725% at 20:41, down 7.2 bps for the week; on August 5 it opened lower at 2.704%. The 30-year German bond yield fell 6.4 bps for the week to 3.640%. The 2/10-year German bond yield spread fell 0.364 bps for the week to +37.985 bps.

headlines.title_en: UK 10-year bond yields fall over 13 basis points this week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (August 7) during the European session tail end, the UK 10-year bond yield fell 2.3 bps to 4.915%, plunging from around 4.94% to near 4.9% upon release of the U.S. nonfarm payrolls report at 20:30 Beijing time, with a weekly cumulative decline of 13.3 bps. The 2-year UK bond yield fell 2.2 bps to 4.276%, plunging from around 4.3% to near 4.25% upon the payrolls release, down 12.5 bps for the week. For the week, the 30-year UK bond yield fell 11.6 bps, and the 50-year UK bond yield fell 9.4 bps. The 2/10-year UK bond yield spread fell 0.922 bps for the week to +63.880 bps.

headlines.title_en: Asset Management Association of China holds exchange symposium with local association members
headlines.summary_en: According to the Asset Management Association of China, from August 4 to 5, 2026, the association held a symposium for local association member exchanges in Hangzhou. The meeting noted that local associations, rooted in their regions and close to the front line, have accumulated rich experience in transmitting regulatory policies, conducting research, building industry-finance matchmaking platforms, and promoting investor education, and are an important part of the industry self-regulatory service system. It is necessary to further improve cooperation mechanisms with local associations, identify effective cooperation points, and strengthen complementarity and synergy—deepening industry cultural development through party building, consolidating talent foundations through training, promoting self-regulation quality and efficiency through supervision, and jointly cultivating cadre teams through exchanges.

headlines.title: 北京：非京籍家庭购房社保个税缴纳年限下调为一年
headlines.summary: 【北京：非京籍家庭购房社保个税缴纳年限下调为一年】北京市住房和城乡建设委员会、北京市规划和自然资源委员会、北京住房公积金管理中心7日晚联合印发《关于进一步优化调整本市房地产政策的通知》，明确非京籍家庭购买五环内商品住房的社保或个税缴纳年限由“2年”，调减为“1年”。调整后，非京籍家庭在全市范围内购买商品住房的社保或个税缴纳年限统一为“1年”，购买商品住房的套数保持不变。即：社保或个税缴纳满1年的非京籍家庭，在五环内可购买1套商品住房，多子女家庭可再多购买1套；在五环外，不限购买套数。

headlines.title_en: Beijing: Non-Beijing household home purchase social security and individual tax payment years reduced to one year
headlines.summary_en: [Beijing: Social insurance or personal income tax payment years for non-Beijing-registered households reduced to one year] The Beijing Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources, and the Beijing Housing Provident Fund Management Center jointly issued the "Notice on Further Optimizing and Adjusting the City's Real Estate Policies" on the evening of the 7th, clarifying that the social insurance or personal income tax payment period for non-Beijing-registered households purchasing commercial housing within the Fifth Ring Road is reduced from "2 years" to "1 year." After the adjustment, the payment period for non-Beijing-registered households purchasing commercial housing across the city is uniformly set at "1 year," with the number of housing units purchasable unchanged. That is, non-Beijing-registered households with one year of social insurance or tax payments can purchase one commercial housing unit within the Fifth Ring Road, with families with multiple children allowed one additional unit; outside the Fifth Ring Road, there is no limit on the number of units.
